text: After their car plunges off a bridge in Winter River, Connecticut, Adam and Barbara Maitland return to their country home as [ghosts trapped inside the house|who_suffers|monsters who suffer], with only a Handbook for the Recently Deceased to guide them. When the Deetz family from New York [move in and remodel everything|trigger|making a new home], only their goth daughter Lydia [can see them|rules|only some can see it]. Desperate, the Maitlands turn to the crude bio-exorcist Betelgeuse, who arrives when [his name is spoken three times|origin|deliberately called up].
